about: Hand-written lay symptom descriptions for the classification outside test. They avoid the corpus wording on purpose. Label = the specialization a clinic would route the patient to.

items.text: I've been running a temperature on and off for three days and my whole body feels beaten up.
items.label: General Medicine

items.text: Since I came back from the village I've had a fever that won't go away and I keep feeling sick to my stomach.
items.label: General Medicine

items.text: I get tired doing nothing, my face looks pale and I'm out of breath just walking to the shop.
items.label: General Medicine

items.text: Sudden fever with terrible pain behind my eyes and my joints ache like crazy.
items.label: General Medicine

items.text: When I rush up the stairs my chest feels heavy and tight, then it goes away after I sit for a bit.
items.label: Cardiology

items.text: The pharmacy machine said my pressure was 160 over 100 and I wake up with a pounding head.
items.label: Cardiology

items.text: Sometimes my heart just starts thumping fast and out of rhythm for no reason.
items.label: Cardiology

items.text: My blood test came back with very high cholesterol and my dad died of a heart attack young.
items.label: Cardiology

items.text: At night I wheeze and cough, especially when it's dusty or cold.
items.label: Pulmonology

items.text: I smoked for 30 years and lately I'm much more breathless and coughing up more phlegm.
items.label: Pulmonology

items.text: High fever, shivering and a chesty cough with green mucus for four days.
items.label: Pulmonology

items.text: A cold two weeks ago left me with a nagging cough that won't settle and a bit of a whistle when I breathe.
items.label: Pulmonology

items.text: Spicy food gives me a burning feeling in my chest and a sour taste comes up when I lie down.
items.label: Gastroenterology

items.text: There's a gnawing ache high up in my stomach that wakes me at 3 am and gets better when I eat.
items.label: Gastroenterology

items.text: My tummy cramps a lot and I go back and forth between constipation and diarrhoea.
items.label: Gastroenterology

items.text: After eating at a wedding I've been vomiting and running to the toilet with watery stools.
items.label: Gastroenterology

items.text: I'm always thirsty, I get up to pee several times a night and cuts take ages to heal.
items.label: Endocrinology

items.text: I've put on weight, I feel cold when everyone else is fine and my skin is very dry.
items.label: Endocrinology

items.text: My hands shake, I sweat a lot and I'm losing weight even though I eat more than ever.
items.label: Endocrinology

items.text: I hardly go outside, my bones ache all the time and I feel weak.
items.label: Endocrinology

items.text: I have dry, itchy patches in the creases of my elbows that flare up every winter.
items.label: Dermatology

items.text: My face keeps breaking out in pimples and blackheads and now my back too.
items.label: Dermatology

items.text: There's a round itchy red patch on my thigh that's slowly getting bigger with a clear middle.
items.label: Dermatology

items.text: I suddenly got itchy raised bumps all over my body after eating prawns.
items.label: Dermatology

items.text: I lifted a heavy box and now my lower back is stiff and hurts when I bend.
items.label: Orthopedics

items.text: My knees creak and ache going down stairs and feel stiff for a few minutes after I wake.
items.label: Orthopedics

items.text: I rolled my ankle playing football and it's swollen and bruised.
items.label: Orthopedics

items.text: For months I haven't been able to lift my arm above my head, the shoulder is stiff and sore.
items.label: Orthopedics

items.text: I get pounding headaches on one side with nausea and I have to lie in a dark room.
items.label: Neurology

items.text: After long days at the computer I get a tight band of pressure around my head.
items.label: Neurology

items.text: My feet burn and tingle like pins and needles, worse at night.
items.label: Neurology

items.text: The room spins for a few seconds whenever I roll over in bed.
items.label: Neurology

items.text: After a cold my ear started hurting and feels blocked, and I can't hear well from it.
items.label: ENT

items.text: I sneeze non-stop in the morning, my nose runs and my eyes itch when there's dust.
items.label: ENT

items.text: My face hurts around my cheeks and forehead and my nose is completely blocked.
items.label: ENT

items.text: It hurts a lot to swallow and my tonsils look swollen with white spots.
items.label: ENT

items.text: My eyes are itchy, red and watering, mostly during spring.
items.label: Ophthalmology

items.text: I woke up with one eye glued shut with yellow crust.
items.label: Ophthalmology

items.text: My eyes feel sandy and burn after a full day staring at screens.
items.label: Ophthalmology

items.text: There's a sore red bump on the rim of my eyelid.
items.label: Ophthalmology

items.text: It stings when I urinate and I feel like I need to go all the time.
items.label: Obstetrics and Gynecology

items.text: My periods come every two or three months, I have acne and hair growing on my chin.
items.label: Obstetrics and Gynecology

items.text: Every month the first two days of my period the cramps are so bad I can't go to class.
items.label: Obstetrics and Gynecology

items.text: I have itching down there and a thick white discharge.
items.label: Obstetrics and Gynecology

items.text: I can't stop worrying about everything, I feel on edge and tense all day.
items.label: Psychiatry

items.text: For over a month I've felt empty and sad and nothing I used to enjoy interests me.
items.label: Psychiatry

items.text: I lie awake for hours every night and feel like a zombie the next day.
items.label: Psychiatry

items.text: Out of nowhere my heart pounds, I can't breathe and I think I'm going to die, then it passes.
items.label: Psychiatry
